verified_facts: Источник датирует выпуск и открытие API 11 ноября 2026 года.
Модель доступна разработчикам через платформу Baidu Qianfan.
Сообщается о контекстном окне в 1 млн токенов и 280 млрд общих параметров при 14 млрд активных на токен.
Публикация описывает намерение Baidu открыть веса по лицензии Apache 2.0, но точная дата зависит от вторичных сообщений.
candidates.significance: Это самостоятельный developer-facing релиз крупной китайской AI-компании: он переводит новую модель из базового релиза в API-доступный preview и заявляет последующее открытие весов.
candidates.limitations: В доступном discovery-источнике нет прямой ссылки на официальный анонс Baidu/Qianfan; заявленные характеристики и дата открытия весов требуют first-party проверки. Базовая ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base уже фигурировала в архиве как отдельный предыдущий релиз.
candidates.archive_reason: Архив содержит ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base от 7 ноября, но не API-preview ERNIE 5.5 Flash, выпущенный позднее.

candidates.title: Fireworks AI breach exposed some Notion AI chat transcripts
candidates.topic: AI infrastructure security; third-party cloud compromise; enterprise AI chat transcripts; data exposure

primary_source.title: Cyberattack on Fireworks AI allowed hackers to access Notion customers’ chat transcripts

supporting_sources.title: Notion says Fireworks breach exposed customer AI chat transcripts

candidates.event_summary: Notion disclosed that the Fireworks AI breach exposed transcripts from its Notion AI Insights feature for a limited subset of workspaces. Notion said it disconnected from Fireworks, deleted vendor-held data and halted related processing after the incident; the broader Fireworks compromise also affected certain customer datasets and billing information.
verified_facts: TechCrunch reports that Fireworks AI said an attacker breached its cloud provider and reached a Fireworks development system, enabling access to some customer data.
Notion confirmed that chat transcripts associated with its AI Insights feature were taken; it said roughly 1% of its customers were affected.
Notion said it disconnected from Fireworks and stopped connectivity on November 3 after being alerted to the incident.

BleepingComputer reports that the exposed Insights transcripts were often unattributable, but Notion advised potentially affected users to rotate passwords, API keys or other credentials entered in the chats.
candidates.significance: The disclosure shows a supply-chain failure in AI infrastructure propagating into a widely used enterprise-workspace product and exposing AI conversation content. It is a material update beyond the underlying Fireworks intrusion because it identifies a major downstream customer, the affected data type and the scope disclosed by that customer.
candidates.limitations: The exact number of affected Notion workspaces, the identity of the attacker and the complete contents of the compromised dataset were not publicly established in the reviewed sources. The underlying Fireworks intrusion occurred earlier, while the Notion-specific impact is the fresh disclosure.
candidates.archive_reason: The archive contains other AI-infrastructure and API-key incidents, but no previous story about Fireworks AI or exposure of Notion AI Insights transcripts.
candidates.verification_notes: Verified across two independent technology-security reports. Both attribute the customer-impact disclosure to Notion and the underlying breach details to Fireworks AI; the reports agree on the affected Notion AI Insights transcripts and mitigation steps.
